visible_text: 決まったことを待っています...
やることを待っています...
まだ発話がありません。
この会議について聞く

answers.q1: Mostly one surface — the transcript panel and the left summary panel share one rounded card with a shared border. But two pieces feel detached: the small pill toolbar at the very top (dot, pause, comment, expand, more, stop) sits half outside the card, overlapping its top edge like a floating HUD/control strip rather than part of the card; and the 'AI が見ている資料' line sits below the card on the bare background, disconnected from the input bar right above it.
answers.q2: Only partially. I can see it's recording a meeting labeled '23:34 の会議' (just a timestamp, not a real title) and that it's 'listening', but there's no participant name, app/source icon, or indication of what audio source (Zoom, Meet, system mic, etc.) it's capturing. I can't tell what specific meeting or source this is.
answers.q3: It's actively recording (red dot, 00:02 elapsed) and listening for speech, but nothing has been transcribed yet — the transcript pane says 'no speech yet', and both the 'decided' and 'to-do' sections are shown as empty placeholders waiting for content to appear.
answers.q4: The recording status (red dot + 00:02, '録音中') paired with the live transcript panel — that's the core state telling you it's actually capturing something right now.
answers.q5: The floating top toolbar's icons (speech bubble, expand, ellipsis) have no labels, so their function isn't obvious. The meeting name is just a time ('23:34の会議'), which doesn't identify the meeting. 'AI が見ている資料' floats outside the card with no visible attached content, so it's unclear what it refers to at this stage.

weaknesses.what: The top pill toolbar overlaps the card's top edge instead of being docked inside it, reading as a separate floating overlay window.
weaknesses.fix: Embed the toolbar as the card's own header bar (flush with the card's top edge and border) instead of a floating pill that straddles the boundary.

weaknesses.what: 'AI が見ている資料' sits outside the main card, below the input bar, on the bare background — visually orphaned from the rest of the surface.
weaknesses.fix: Move it inside the card, e.g. as a small footer row beneath the chat input, so it reads as part of the same panel.

weaknesses.what: Nothing identifies the meeting source (which app/call, which participants) — only a generic timestamp title and a generic 'listening' state.
weaknesses.fix: Show the source app icon/name or a real meeting title near '23:34の会議' so the user knows what it's actually capturing.
